body: Review scope: an independent adversarial review of 549b257 (T35) in a separate subagent context. The verdict was 'incorrect'; each finding and its disposition is recorded below.
author: claude-code

body: P3: the claim that the worker's attach recognizes its pane was false for a worktree-seated worker, because seats were read at the worktree.
author: claude-code

replies.body: Fixed in 903c9fa: seats are now read at the main checkout, resolved from the git common dir. Tested by test_worker_seat_label_comes_from_the_worker_worktree_registration.
replies.author: claude-code

body: P3: the file mode changed from 100644 to 100755.
author: claude-code

replies.body: Fixed in 903c9fa: restored to 100644. The flip came from chmod +x in my baseline swap.
replies.author: claude-code

body: P2: every team member was mapped to <kind>-worker, so another member's pane made the worker ambiguous, heal split a duplicate worker, and restart refused.
author: claude-code

replies.body: Fixed in 903c9fa: only the pair's own worker-type seat is the worker (the HERDR_AGENTS_WORKER_WORKTREE seat, or a legacy -aNNN at the main checkout). Tested by test_another_team_members_pane_is_not_a_second_worker, which fails on 549b257.
replies.author: claude-code

body: P3: the member type was ignored, so under worker_kind=codex a claude-code member would be relabeled codex-worker.
author: claude-code

replies.body: Fixed in 903c9fa: worker seats are looked up by the worker agmsg type only.
replies.author: claude-code

body: P3: team.sh --json (about 1.8 s live) ran on every attach.
author: claude-code

replies.body: Fixed in 903c9fa: team.sh is gone, and seat labels now come from two or three identities.sh lookups.
replies.author: claude-code

body: P2: the orchestrator's attach found the worker only by its herdr agent name, which upstream renames, so it refused and skipped bootstrap and repair.
author: claude-code

replies.body: Fixed in 903c9fa: attach falls back to labeled_worker_pane_id for both the tab and the workspace lookup. Tested by test_attach_completes_bootstrap_on_a_self_named_pair, which fails on 549b257.
replies.author: claude-code

body: P3: missing tests: a third member pane, an attach that completes, mixed labels, and the HOME guard.
anchor: def write_self_named_pair(self, *extra_panes: str, extra_workspace_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> None:
author: claude-code

replies.body: Addressed in 903c9fa: 4 new tests (3 fail on 549b257, mixed labels is a regression guard). The HOME guard is covered by the existing test_full_mode_skips_agmsg_bootstrap_for_home, which failed during development until the guard was added.
replies.author: claude-code
